tasks.spec: You are a one-task Ringer probe worker isolating why createDocument lineItems newCostItem elements fail union resolution in JobTread Pave. Twenty staged documents fail with: The value {"newCostItem":{name, unitId, quantity, unitPrice, costCodeId, costTypeId, description}} at createDocument.$.lineItems.0 does not resolve to existingCostGroup/existingCostItem/newCostGroup/newCostItem. Hypotheses: (A) document-context newCostItem rejects costCodeId/costTypeId keys; (B) the specific costTypeId used ('22PazefY5x4j') or costCodeId ('22PbdLkpZX5s') is invalid in this context; (C) some other inner-field constraint (e.g. name length). BOUNDARY: you may create AT MOST 3 temporary documents on ONE pilot job in JobTread org 22PazeRM5FCH, and you MUST delete every document you create before finishing (deleteDocument op) and prove deletion by read-back; no other mutations of any kind; never touch existing entities; deliverables are your only file writes; never log the grant key. CREDS: set -a; source /Users/chussey/.config/cleverwork/master.env; set +a. Build request bodies with python3 json.dumps only. Pave: POST https://api.jobtread.com/pave with {"query": {"$": {"grantKey": "<$JT_SUPABASE_MIRROR_GRANT_KEY>"}, ...}}. Pick the target job: any jt_id from jt_mirror.crosswalk where jt_type='job' (Supabase read: curl -s -X POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/rnhmvcpsvtqjlffpsayu/database/query -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"select jt_id from jt_mirror.crosswalk where jt_type='\''job'\'' limit 1"}'). PRIOR ROUNDS (see ../r3h-lineitem-probe/ and ../r3h3-lineitem-probe/): every WRAPPED variant ({"newCostItem": {...}} and {"existingCostItem": {...}}) fails union resolution regardless of inner fields. NEW HYPOTHESIS: Pave resolves this union by the BARE element's key set — no wrapper key at all; the variant names in the error are type names, not object keys. The original bare attempt lacked ANY discriminating key (no costItemId, no costTypeId) so it matched nothing. PROBE SEQUENCE (stop at first success): V8 = lineItems: [ BARE {"name": "Probe Item", "unitId": <real unit id>, "quantity": 1, "unitCost": 8, "unitPrice": 10, "costCodeId": "22PbdLkpZX5s", "costTypeId": "22PazefY5x4j", "description": "probe"} ]. V9 = lineItems: [ BARE {"costItemId": <jt_id of an executed catalog_items row from jt_mirror.crosswalk jt_type='costItem'>, "quantity": 1} ]. V10 = V8 without costCodeId (costTypeId as sole discriminator). V11 (only if V8-V10 fail) = V8 plus "documentId" omitted but "isSelected": true added (grasping — record whatever the errors say precisely). Record each full request (grantKey redacted) and full response. CLEANUP: deleteDocument each created id, then re-query it and show null/error proof. DELIVERABLES: /Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r3h3-lineitem-probe/probe-output.json (array of {variant, request, response, cleanup}) and .../r3h3-lineitem-probe/probe-transcript.md with sections ## Probe Goal, ## Commands Run, ## Observed Behavior, ## Winning Shape (exact JSON element shape that succeeded, or 'none succeeded'), ## Cleanup Proof, ## Verdict. HARD RULES: never claim a variant worked unless the response contained a created document id; if all fail, that is a valid honest outcome — capture every error verbatim.
tasks.check: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('/Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r3h3-lineitem-probe/probe-output.json')); t=open('/Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r3h3-lineitem-probe/probe-transcript.md').read(); assert isinstance(d,list) and len(d)>=1, 'no probe attempts recorded'; assert any('response' in x for x in d), 'no responses captured'; assert 'winning shape' in t.lower(), 'transcript missing Winning Shape section'; assert 'cleanup proof' in t.lower(), 'transcript missing Cleanup Proof'; assert all('cleanup' in x for x in d if x.get('created_id')), 'created doc without cleanup record'; import re; key=[l.split('=',1)[1].strip() for l in open('/Users/chussey/.config/cleverwork/master.env') if l.startswith('JT_SUPABASE_MIRROR_GRANT_KEY=')][0].strip('\"').strip(\"'\"); blob=json.dumps(d)+t; assert key not in blob, 'SECRET LEAK in probe deliverables'; print('PASS - probe recorded with cleanup and no key leak')"
